parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host. 
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。 
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the audit policy.
You can invoke the ListReviewRules operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
审计规则ID。
您可以调用ListReviewRules接口获取该参数
parameters.name: review_rule_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the audit policy. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with a special character and can contain only the following special characters: periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), backslashes (), and spaces
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的审计规则名称。长度为1-128个字符，不能以特殊字符开头，只可包含特殊字符中的'.'、'_'、'-'、'\'以及空格
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The new description of the audit policy. The description can be up to 500 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定修改后的审计规则备注。最多500个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The type of the auditable asset scope rule after modification. Valid values:

1: All projects.

2: Specified projects
parameters.help_zh:
指定修改后可审计的资产范围规则类型。取值：

1：所有项目。

2：指定项目
parameters.name: scope_type

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
